homeolog_detail: A/D homoeologs are not separated by the assay; D-genome probes simply fail on an AABB panel
outcome_definition: Array assay OUTCOME on a 288-accession durum (AABB) panel, as classified by the 90K iSelect pipeline: 'failed' = no usable call; 'polymorphic' = a call that segregates in the panel. Printed polymorphic % uses the NON-FAILED denominator (paper's footnote); the failed % uses all scored assays. Neither is a KASP conversion rate (this is an array, not KASP).
source_file: BMC Genomics 20:268, Table 2 (article XML, not a supplement): "Number of failed, polymorphic and total SNPs in the assay"
